signal: dbt Labs announced an October 2025 merger with Fivetran to form a combined data infrastructure company with nearly $600M in revenue, reshaping the GTM and product roadmap.

email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Olivia, saw dbt Labs is merging with Fivetran into a nearly $600M combined data infrastructure business.

A merger that size usually means a far bigger addressable account list than the combined team can cover while motions are still being aligned, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Olivia, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

When two GTM motions combine, the pipeline target usually jumps before enablement and headcount catch up. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings dbt Labs needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Olivia, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs' reply rate likely compares to other data infrastructure teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Olivia, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Mid-merger, GTM attention is stretched thin, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a combined GTM motion? I'll tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
